headlines.text: Rewind to 2026, when Darby Allin vs. Mike Bailey clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.52 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Darby Allin was chasing gold for the 10th time. In his seventh title defense in as many weeks, a battered Allin locked in back-to-back Scorpion Deathlocks ? the second broken free from a Coffin Drop reversal ? to force Mike Bailey to tap just days before his Hair vs. Title showdown with MJF.
On this day in 2022, Uno, Ten & Del Sol touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.76.
Turning the clock back to 2020: it was the first-ever encounter between Rey Fenix and Orange Cassidy on Dynamite, rated 6.50.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2026, when Mark Briscoe vs. Tommaso Ciampa settled things in an Anything Goes match on Dynamite, rated 8.50 ? an incredible outing.

Rewind to 2026, when Matt Jackson reached a milestone worth celebrating: their 150th match in AEW, facing Andrade & Davis & Ricochet vs. Young Bucks & Jericho, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 6.60 in a wild trios sprint.
On this day in 2022, it was the first-ever encounter between Danielson & Moxley and Dante & Sydal, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.46 ? a good, competitive contest.
